title: [ICCTN] EchoShard
description: Adds Echo Shard crafting and a short Deep Dark advancement progression including Recovery Compass crafting and Warden encounters.
body:
A simple datapack that adds a crafting recipe for Echo Shards and a small advancement progression centered around the Deep Dark.

Progress includes:
- Crafting Echo Shards
- Crafting a Recovery Compass
- Warden encounter advancement
